description: This file contains unit tests for the DbBackedDependencySafeDelete functionality within a data asset management backend system. It verifies that assets can be deleted safely and that subsequent attempts to access deleted assets yield a 404 Not Found response.

classes.name: DbBackedDependencySafeDeleteTests
classes.description: A test class utilizing xUnit to verify the safe deletion of dependency assets in a database-backed system. Contains setup via fixture and multiple test methods to confirm behavior.

methods.name: Delete_asset_is_persistent_and_subsequent_get_returns_404
methods.description: An asynchronous test method that creates an asset, deletes it via API, then confirms that subsequent fetch returns a 404 Not Found status.
